scope: D3 TRAIN corpus only; benchmark DEV and frozen TEST prohibited
split: same episode-level 12% held-out TRAIN split used by jenga_w6_simple.py

causal_inputs.action: original eight-step nominal action reconstructed algebraically from the initial endpoint pair and saved alphas
causal_inputs.execution_uncertainty: eight-step xyz residual direction reconstructed from the initial endpoint pair
causal_inputs.prohibited: physical trajectories, response curves, midpoint choices, deeper nested endpoints, task/failure/topple/success labels

features: 117 raw values: current state 61 + nominal action 8x4 + residual direction 8x3; standardized using fit groups only
target: capacity-balanced three-mode oracle assignment plus standardized 15-dimensional physical-minus-D2 scale-curve residual

router.architecture: MLP 117-64-32 with GELU and 0.1 dropout; categorical mode head and auxiliary 15D residual head
router.loss: cross entropy plus 0.5 times smooth-L1 residual loss
router.selection: fixed final epoch; no held-out model or epoch selection

primary_summary: median across the ten fixed seeds

feasibility_gate.interpretation: all conditions must pass before any new DEV run

small_sample_warning: held-out TRAIN has only four clearly smooth groups; smooth FPR is therefore descriptive but remains a conservative veto
